promptIntent.wide: Corrected fictional open-wheel car scene on a floodlit desert circuit at night; 16:9; car low center-right; left side kept dark for menu UI; two asymmetrical angular monoliths joined by a low bridge, irregular faceted solar canopies, and low modular pit buildings.
promptIntent.portrait: Portrait companion derived from the corrected wide art direction; 9:16; matching car and angular architecture in the lower quarter; upper 58 to 62 percent and central column kept dark for stacked mobile UI.

promptConstraints: No text, numbers, flags, readable signage, logos, pseudo-logos, sponsor marks, team liveries, watermarks, or UI.
No Formula 1 or FIA branding and no identifiable real-circuit architecture or landmark.
No circular tiered towers, conical or sail roofs, domes, or repeating tent-canopy silhouettes.
One fictional car only; no recognizable trade dress.

independentAssetReview.notes: Revision 1 was rejected because its circular tiered tower and sail-canopy combination strongly recalled a real circuit. Revision 2 replaces those elements with asymmetrical angular monoliths, a bridge, and faceted solar canopies; the corrected wide and portrait masters passed an independent visual, consistency, artifact, and brand-mark review.

humanIpReview.notes: No external human or legal review has been claimed. User approval is the gate before expanding this art direction to the remaining tracks.
